title: Build TodoList component with filtering
description:
Create the TodoList component that renders a filtered list of TodoItem components. The component receives the full todos array, the current filter state ('all' | 'active' | 'completed'), and action callbacks (onToggle, onDelete, onEdit). It filters the todos based on the active filter before rendering. When no todos match the current filter, it displays an appropriate empty state. The list should render each todo using the TodoItem component.

Source: internal/specs/todo-app-SPEC.md Section 5.5

functional: 'All' filter shows all todos regardless of status
'Active' filter shows only todos where completed is false
'Completed' filter shows only todos where completed is true
Each todo renders as a TodoItem with correct props
edge_cases: Empty list displays empty state gracefully
No matching todos for current filter shows empty state
Deleting the last todo shows empty state

testing_requirements.target: Renders correct todos for each filter state
Empty state renders when no todos match
